description.intro: The Nike Netherlands Academy drawstring backpack is perfect for carrying your equipment lightly and comfortably at any time. Inspired by the Dutch national team, it offers a sober and functional design ideal for training or daily use.
key_benefits: Lightweight design: Perfect for carrying essentials without adding extra weight.
Quick access: Lace-up closure system to open and close in seconds.
Official Holland style: Represent your team in every training session.
Daily and sports use: Ideal for gym, training or urban use.
